title: Arcana Core Field: Progression
summary: Progress Arcana Core by expanding contracts before adding risky magic behavior.

blocks.title: Foundation First
blocks.body: Add shared records and validation before gameplay effects. The foundation should compile and load without optional modules.

blocks.title: Then Knowledge
blocks.body: Publish records to Arcane Index and Grimoire so players can understand magic before they rely on it in a dangerous route.

blocks.title: Then Consequences
blocks.body: Only deepen curses, forbidden pages, rifts, or high-risk relics once the shared services and knowledge links are repeatable.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
